item.title: Recreational screen use and internalizing problems from preadolescence to young adulthood in a longitudinal twin cohort with co-twin comparison
item.content:encoded:
Nature Human Behaviour, Published online: 08 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41562-026-02607-0

Using longitudinal twin data, this study finds that associations between youth recreational screen use and internalizing problems are substantially reduced within twin pairs, suggesting shared familial contributions to the observed association.

item.title: Microdelays disrupt online learning
item.content:encoded:
Nature Human Behaviour, Published online: 08 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41562-026-02598-y

Analysing data from more than 80,000 students and aspiring coders, Mazar et al. show that microdelays, brief loading lags caused by slow internet connections, can impair online learning.
